mavis_analysis: DATA-DRIVEN, NOT TEMPLATE-BASED. I'm reading the actual market structure right now (22:35 IST, Wed 26-Aug). NIFTY is at 24,207 with a strong bear trend (EMA9 < EMA21 < EMA50), RSI at 29 (oversold), trading near S1 support (24,151) and BB lower band (24,021). The 1-day expected move is ±242 pts, giving a probable range of 23,966 to 24,450. CRITICAL: Tomorrow Thu 27-Aug is NIFTY MONTHLY EXPIRY — the last Thursday of August. That means maximum OI concentration, max-pain pinning at ~24,200-24,300, aggressive theta burn in the last 2 hours, and whipsaw risk in the last 30 min. I am NOT going to use a fixed 9am-3:15pm template. My decision will be data-driven at each phase of the day. Given: (1) bear trend + oversold = mean-reversion risk upward, (2) global cues negative (US futures -0.3%, DXY +0.25%, crude +0.95%) = risk-off pressure, (3) options cheap (VIX 10.56, but vol crush in last 2h), (4) monthly expiry OI gravity toward 24,200-24,300. Best edge: RANGE TRAPPING iron condor at 24,200/24,300 PE/PE 24,000/24,100 PE/CE wait — the correct condor is: SELL 24,200 PE + BUY 24,000 PE (put spread) AND SELL 24,300 CE + BUY 24,500 CE (call spread). Net credit target: Rs.30-40 per share (Rs.2,250-3,000 total per wing, Rs.4,500-6,000 total condor). Max loss: 200 - credit = ~170 per share = Rs.12,750 max. I will WAIT until 09:45 IST to read opening range, gap, volume, and OI shift. NO TRADE before 09:45 IST. If NIFTY breaks 24,000 OR 24,400 with volume by 11:00 IST, I switch to alternative_1 (directional). If the open is muted and VIX stays <11, I take the condor.

primary.name: NIFTY Iron Condor (monthly expiry)
primary.structure: SELL 24200 PE (short put, 8 pts ITM) + BUY 24000 PE (long put, 200 pts below short) AND SELL 24300 CE (short call, 92 pts OTM) + BUY 24500 CE (long call, 292 pts OTM).
primary.rationale: Sell ATM-ish strikes where premium is fat and OI is heavy. Buy wings 200-300 pts away for protection. Net width 200 PE / 200 CE. Iron condor = directional-neutral, range-bound play. Profits from theta + range contraction.
primary.entry_trigger: ONLY enter if by 09:45 IST: (1) NIFTY spot is in 24,150-24,300 range, AND (2) realized vol in first 30 min < 1.0% of spot, AND (3) SGX NIFTY / US futures haven't moved > 0.3% overnight. Skip if NIFTY has gapped > 0.5% on the day OR if first 30-min range is > 200 pts.
primary.target_premium: Rs.30-40 per share on the condor (Rs.2,250-3,000 per side, Rs.4,500-6,000 total)
primary.stop_loss: Either wing reaches Rs.80/share loss → close that wing immediately. Combined loss > Rs.4,000 (40% of capital at risk) → close entire condor.
primary.time_stop: Close by 14:30 IST (force-square window — 1 hour before settlement). Monthly expiry whipsaw in last 30 min is NOT worth holding. NO overnight carry.
primary.adjustment: If NIFTY moves to within 50 pts of 24,200 PE short strike by 11:30, BUY back 24,200 PE (closing half) to lock in remaining premium on the call side.
primary.validity: Valid for Thu 27-Aug ONLY. Will re-analyze Wed evening for Fri 28-Aug weekly expiry.

alternative_1.name: Directional bearish (if breakdown below 24,000)
alternative_1.trigger: If NIFTY breaks below 24,000 with volume > 1.5x 5d-average by 11:00 IST, AND the break is NOT a wick (closes below on 15min candle)
alternative_1.stop: NIFTY closes back above 24,100 on 30min candle — exit at 50% premium
alternative_1.rationale: Bear trend + global cues negative + monthly expiry pinning breakdown could accelerate. Risk-defined, not naked short.

alternative_2.name: Directional bullish mean-reversion (if washout low near 24,000)
alternative_2.trigger: If NIFTY opens weak, dips to 24,000-24,050 in first 30 min, then bounces with volume back above 24,100 by 10:00
alternative_2.stop: NIFTY breaks back below 24,000 on 15min candle — exit
alternative_2.rationale: Oversold RSI 29 + monthly expiry OI support at 24,000 + bear-trend oversold bounce.

alternative_3.name: DO NOT TRADE (no-edge day)
alternative_3.trigger: If by 09:45 IST: NIFTY is in tight range (<0.3% width = 73 pts) AND VIX <10 AND global futures flat — WAIT for direction
alternative_3.rationale: Monthly expiry + low VIX + flat global = max-pain magnet, both sides get chopped. Better to sit out than pay theta both ways.

intraday_decision_tree.phase_1_pre_market_08_25_to_09_15: Read thesis cron output. Check SGX NIFTY (if accessible), US futures, crude, DXY. If any of these moved >0.3%, mentally re-rank alternatives.
intraday_decision_tree.phase_2_opening_09_15_to_09_45: OBSERVE ONLY. Do not place orders. Read: opening range (first 30 min high/low), gap (open vs prev close 24,207.75), volume vs 5d avg, OI shift in top 5 strikes. Log the OR high and OR low — these become intraday pivots.
intraday_decision_tree.phase_3_decision_09_45_to_10_00: Apply entry_trigger logic for primary (iron condor) vs alternatives 1/2/3. If no clear signal, NO TRADE.
intraday_decision_tree.phase_4_early_management_10_00_to_11_30: If condor entered: monitor delta. If one wing delta > 0.30 → consider adjustment. If directional: trail stop.
intraday_decision_tree.phase_5_midday_11_30_to_13_30: Manage position. Reduce position size if realized vol spikes > 1.5x. No new entries (avoid mid-day noise).
intraday_decision_tree.phase_6_afternoon_13_30_to_14_30: Hold winners. Close anything net-negative. Lock in profits on condor if combined credit collected > 70%.
intraday_decision_tree.phase_7_force_square_14_30_to_15_00: HARD CLOSE all positions by 14:30. Use strike-aware pricing. Monthly expiry whipsaw in last 30 min is NOT worth the gamma risk. Even if position is at max profit, take the money and walk.
intraday_decision_tree.phase_8_settlement_15_00_to_15_30: Any positions not closed: bot's hard-kill (FIX #3) at 15:15 forces emergency close. Theta burns most remaining time value — accept the close price.
